# Sports Cheat Sheet: Daily News

> Sports Cheat Sheet is a sports small talk app for people who do not follow sports: a five-minute daily briefing with source-linked talking points. No account.

## App

- [Sports Small Talk App | Sports Cheat Sheet: Daily News](https://jackwallner.com/ios/sports/index.html.md): Sports Cheat Sheet is a sports small talk app for people who do not follow sports: a five-minute daily briefing with source-linked talking points. No account.

## Guides

- [How to Talk About Sports When You Don't Follow Sports](https://jackwallner.com/ios/sports/how-to-talk-about-sports.html.md): Small talk for non-fans: one story to know, one question to ask, sample lines for work and dinner, and what to skip so you never get caught bluffing.
